### Description

Currently i'm facing an issue with cuSolver:

```bash
uv venv
uv pip install -U "jax[cuda12]"
source .venv/bin/activate
python
```

```python
import jax.numpy as jnp; jnp.linalg.solve(jnp.array([[1]]), jnp.array([1]))
```

E0714 16:40:03.040179   40365 pjrt_stream_executor_client.cc:2916] Execution of replica 0 failed: INTERNAL: jaxlib/gpu/solver_handle_pool.cc:37: operation gpusolverDnCreate(&handle) failed: cuSolver internal error
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<stdin>", line 1, in <module>
jaxlib._jax.XlaRuntimeError: INTERNAL: jaxlib/gpu/solver_handle_pool.cc:37: operation gpusolverDnCreate(&handle) failed: cuSolver internal error


- a different system on jetpack 6.2.0 has the same problem
- the suggestions mentioned in [https://github.com/jax-ml/jax/issues/29042](https://github.com/jax-ml/jax/issues/29042) did not fix the problem
